findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hardcoded in plaintext within the Lambda environment variables, which are visible to anyone with describe/read permissions on the function and are stored in source control, effectively compromising these credentials.
The function uses nodejs12.x, which is an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security patches, increasing exposure to unpatched vulnerabilities.

findings.issue_category: missing encryption configuration for environment variables
findings.description: No KMS customer-managed key is specified for encrypting environment variables, relying on default encryption rather than explicit key management with auditable access controls.
